label: early original-phase input of l/c/2/q/3/o/w, conditioned on sequence starting with f/j/g/u/r/0/b/h
explanation: Active almost only in the original (input) phase (99.8% of mass), at positions t=2..5 (peak t=3, 53% of mass; never t<2, essentially never t>=6, delimiter or copy). Within that window it is gated by the current input token: l (6.5x lift), c, 2, q, 3, o, w, mostly on their first occurrence (in_first=1 holds 98% of mass). Magnitude is boosted by early context: first token f/j/g/u/r/0 (3-4x lift) and prev2_tok in the same set; top activations (~0.18-0.20) are l or c at t=3 after sequences starting with f/g/j. Looks like an additive input-token x early-context conjunction, so the boolean predicate is lossy: dev F1 0.54, mass recall 0.70. Misses are the same tokens with other first tokens (e.g. e e a l) or weaker tokens (1, z); false positives are the trigger tokens at t=4-5 or after weak contexts.
